label: 3. Hello, Commander. This is Tetra Connect. We ru…

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: Hello, Commander. This is Tetra Connect. We run the Ark's entertainment industry.

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: We contacted you again because we have a new plan for a video.
Talk to the hand. I'm not listening.

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: Trust us, we're sure you'll find this offer enticing.

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: All you have to do is film Nikkes engaged in combat with Raptures on the surface.

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: Whether or not you capture the Raptures is of no concern to us.

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: Just make sure you get some great hero shots of the Nikkes as they're in the thick of it.
What are you getting out of this?

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: Two things.

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: One is that we want to maintain a good relationship with you.

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: You are the rising deity of the Ark right now.

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: It would be wise on our part to continue having a working relationship with such a person.

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: Since we previously came off so ill-mannered, albeit unintentionally, we wish to make up for it.

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: The second has to do with the Elysion company.

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: They asked us to produce a Nikke advertisement for them.

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: It just so happens that two of your Nikkes come from Elysion.

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: We'll edit the footage together to make it look like they're in the midst of a real battle.

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: Since we'll be using actual footage from up on the surface, it will have a wonderful verisimilitude to it.
So it's going to be used as a training advertisement?

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: Correct.

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: Well, what do you say?
If that's what the footage is actually going to be used for, then I'll cooperate.

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: I knew you'd come around.

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: We're all looking forward to your footage.
